text:
mira: Uploading a new mock for rollout state pills — compact mode where each version shows a small pill with percent, health, and a chevron to expand details. sam: Nice. Question: when expanded, is it a popover or an inline reveal? For keyboard users popover can trap focus. mira: Design is inline reveal below the pill so it keeps timeline context. We want Enter/Space to toggle, and left/right to scrub versions. jordan: Inline + scrub sounds good. Concern: screen reader announcing the percent change when scrubbed. We need aria-live region. tayla: Agree. Proposed ARIA: ```
Version 12 — canary 5% — healthy
``` Also add `aria-controls` from pill to detail region. kevin: UX nit: the chevron-only affordance is hard to hit on mobile. Can we make the whole pill tappable and keep a subtle focus ring? mira: Yes, whole pill tappable on touch. Focus ring will be 3px accent token. We'll add a larger hit target for mobile. sam: Another accessibility note: when user holds arrow keys to scrub, we should debounce announcements to not overwhelm SR — maybe batch updates every 200ms. a11y-bot: Automated a11y check: color contrast of percent chip fails at 3%. Recommend #1F2937 for text on pale-yellow chip. jordan: Also, rollback button inside expanded view — should it be destructive color? Might scare people. Suggest a secondary destructive with confirm dialog. mira: Plan: keep rollback as secondary-danger (outline red) + confirm modal with small delay option ("Schedule rollback in 30s") so accidental clicks can be undone. tayla: For keyboard users, modal must trap focus and return focus to pill after close. Add `aria-describedby` for modal text. kevin: Microinteraction: when scrub reaches a snapshot with a test failure tag, show a small warning icon in the pill and announce "test failure at this version". mira: Love that. I'll iterate mocks and add a tiny animation when pill expands. Will post updated frames tomorrow. sam: Can you add a short prototype for keyboard scrub? I can user-test the flow with 3 engineers. mira: Yep — prototype link: https://invision.redwood/mock/rollout-pill-scrub jordan: LGTM overall. One last thought: add an option in settings to "compact rollouts" that toggles this UI so users who prefer dense lists can opt-in. mira: Good call. Adding to spec. Thanks everyone :heart:
